content:
cslib#944 proposes a (computable) definition of cut elimination for linear logic. It's the first development where I felt that having the code in the CSLib repo as context made a pretty significant difference in AI performance.
(Outside of simpler tasks like 'do X inspired by how Y was done in that other directory'.)
cool! i’ve always thought formalising cut elimination algorithms would be a major headache but clearly nothing is out of reach in our brave new world
AI for boring case analysis! :nerd:
